concepts.subject: Diverse Team Meeting Room
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a bright and airy meeting room with a diverse team of professionals seated around a wooden table, warm lighting, neutral color palette, and a positive mood. Capture from a slightly elevated angle, with some team members looking at laptops and others engaged in conversation. Incorporate plants and a city view outside the window.
concepts.title: Diverse Team In Modern Meeting Room
concepts.description: A group of diverse professionals are seated around a wooden table in a modern meeting room, engaged in discussion and looking at laptops. The room has a city view and is decorated with plants.

concepts.subject: Active Senior Hiking Outdoors
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a scenic outdoor scene of a senior adult hiking on a winding trail, surrounded by lush green trees and a misty mountain landscape. Use a warm and natural lighting style, with a focus on the subject's active and determined expression. Incorporate a walking stick and a backpack, and capture from a slightly low angle to convey a sense of adventure.
concepts.title: Senior Adult Hiking In Nature Reserve
concepts.description: A senior adult is hiking on a winding trail in a nature reserve, surrounded by lush green trees and a misty mountain landscape. The subject is using a walking stick and wearing a backpack.
